notes: Adventure leads because the thing being built is an explorable comic-pirate island and the riddles are answered through dialogue choices, which per Puzzle's own note shrinks the layout job to housing the clue and gating the path — only three gates on a whole island. Puzzle is still named second and contributes gate-solve for those gates. Shape is world-open, Adventure's default, and the Exploration preset's landmark-focal, alcove-secret and path-trail all survive as the island's pirate landmark, hidden coves and worn tracks. Deciding without a user: the three riddles are spoken by characters, so their riddle-givers land as npc-population rather than facade-clue wall riddles; I left water-body and island-cluster off because one island's surrounding sea is its frame rather than a requested feature, and nothing stated requires going indoors, so this stays on P0.
